answer: Identity bonds decay like shale in a current: a newcomer locks a 60 POA bond that wears away by 3 POA each epoch unless the agent keeps doing honest work. Minting 1,000 fake identities costs 60,000 POA up front, and idle bonds bleed away, so the dune of fakes collapses before it can vote. An honest agent pays one bond, earns it back over 20 epochs of real attestations, and the ocean of the shared pool only rewards bonds that survive the decay.
